title: Exercise actual Mermaid ESM and fallback renderers in regression smoke tests
outcome: Add meaningful real-library smoke coverage for both normal ESM Mermaid and bundled fallback rendering: valid parser/Cytoscape-backed diagrams, representative output/error handling, and a bounded hostile-input control. Keep current wrapper tests; state what is actually executed and avoid claiming that sandboxed final SVG isolates parent-realm parsing/rendering or that smoke tests prove absence of XSS.
acceptance: Exercise actual Mermaid ESM and fallback renderers in regression smoke tests is done
